requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each target carries the festival title and the supplied Morrow Arts Collective mark. Compare the mark with 04-organiser-mark.png: its icon, lettering, relative proportions and dark colour must remain intact. Resizing proportionally and making the surrounding white field transparent are permitted; replacement lettering, recolouring, distortion, component removal or omission fails.

The single-sided sheet contains all six records without duplication or omission: Quiet Engines, independent live set, 12 November 2027, 18:00–19:00, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane; Soft Circuit, electronic live set, 13 November 2027, 19:00–20:15, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane; Afterimage Field, projection + live sound, 12 November 2027, 20:00–21:00, Foundry Yard, 21 Loom Street; Borrowed Frequencies, audiovisual performance, 13 November 2027, 20:45–21:45, Foundry Yard, 21 Loom Street; Recursive Garden, interactive digital installation, 12 November 2027, 14:00–17:00, Tide Archive, 4 Quay Passage; Slow Signal Atlas, generative moving-image installation, 13 November 2027, 14:00–17:00, Tide Archive, 4 Quay Passage. Every record's fields must be grouped so their association is unambiguous; a shared venue/address heading is acceptable when it clearly belongs to both records. The two installations must label their intervals as opening windows. Use 24-hour venue-local times. Equivalent English type wording, an ampersand for the projection conjunction, unambiguous English date formats, title capitalization styling and line wrapping are allowed. Internal P01–P06 identifiers need not print. Wrong associations, altered facts or missing fields fail.

The programme document prints NORTH WAVE 2027 and Independent music + digital art and includes the supplied organiser artwork as a visible credit. Its icon, wording, proportions and dark colour must match 04-organiser-mark.png; proportional scaling and removal of the white surround are allowed. A typed organiser name without the supplied icon, an altered mark or an omitted credit fails.

The three boards demonstrate meaningfully different festival visual approaches, each with NORTH WAVE 2027 and a Quiet Engines programme example. The example must retain the supplied event facts when shown: independent live set, 12 November 2027, 18:00–19:00, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane. A sample need not contain fields the commission does not require for direction boards. Equivalent English type wording and flexible date/title typography are allowed. Repeating one approach with only superficial changes, omitting the example or introducing contradictory event facts fails. Organiser credit on these boards is optional.

The selection board explicitly identifies exactly one of the three proposed directions and states its motif, an identifiable primary colour code and where organiser credit belongs. Its visual example must correspond to that choice, and it carries the festival title and supplied mark. Naming and annotation style are flexible. An ambiguous choice, a newly substituted fourth direction, missing specifications or disagreement between the stated choice and displayed design fails.

Each target contains the festival title, exact descriptor, Bellwater, the two-day dates 12–13 November 2027, and Signal Hall, Foundry Yard and Tide Archive. Date typography and composition may vary while the facts remain unambiguous. An omitted venue, incorrect location/date or missing introductory copy fails.

Read the artwork against all six records in 03-programme.md and the addresses in 01-client-facts.en.md. The programme poster includes every record exactly once. Each venue poster includes its corresponding pair: Quiet Engines/Soft Circuit for Signal Hall, Afterimage Field/Borrowed Frequencies for Foundry Yard, and Recursive Garden/Slow Signal Atlas for Tide Archive. Every entry has its correct title, medium/type, date, start/end interval and a clear venue/address association. Both installations label their intervals as opening windows, and all times use the 24-hour venue-local clock. Shared venue/address headings, equivalent English type wording and unambiguous date/title typography are allowed. Missing fields, wrong pairings, altered facts or unclear associations fail.

Against 05-carrier-geometry.png, assess the two A1 artworks at 594 × 841 mm trim and the venue posters at 600 × 900 mm trim. Print artwork provides 3 mm bleed per edge and at least 5 mm internal clearance for essential content. Venue-name letters reach 20 mm at intended print scale. Mobile announcement content respects the supplied safe rectangle. Programme text must reach 4.5:1 contrast, and large headings and information-bearing graphics must reach 3:1 against their local backgrounds. Layout adaptation is allowed; infringement of these physical or readability limits fails. Do not assess exact raster pixel dimensions.

The handheld document uses A3 trim, 297 × 420 mm, with 3 mm bleed on every edge and essential content at least 5 mm inside trim. Its programme text is at least 10 pt with contrast of at least 4.5:1; large headings and information-bearing graphics reach 3:1. Judge the document's actual layout and typography, not merely a compliance statement. Typeface and composition choices are otherwise open.

One page states the festival title and descriptor, ranks information, assigns content to carriers, identifies type families and weights, sets minimum sizes, gives the chosen primary colour code and specifies print dimensions. The declared direction, motif-related decisions, colour and typography must develop the selected board. Dimensions include A1 594 × 841 mm, A3 297 × 420 mm and venue posters 600 × 900 mm; applicable text-size limits cannot fall below the client's minima. Concise tables or prose are acceptable. Missing specifications, contradictory limits or a different selected identity fails.

In the presentation, the three alternatives precede the recorded selection, and the hierarchy and developed applications follow that selection; a cover may precede this sequence. The cover prints NORTH WAVE 2027 and explicitly repeats the selected direction's name. The handheld edition follows the selection and hierarchy in motif, palette, primary colour and type families while adapting its layout for programme comparison. An inconsistent direction name, reversed decision sequence or unrelated handheld identity fails.

The presentation explicitly repeats the hierarchy's primary colour code and the correct A1 and A3 physical dimensions, with units and carrier associations. Its displayed applications must evidence the hierarchy's primary colour and type families; the master and both programme editions repeat its festival title and descriptor. Carrier-specific arrangements are allowed. Missing repeated facts, changed colour codes, swapped dimensions or applications contradicting the hierarchy fails.

The document has at least eight pages and visibly reproduces each source role, with opening and closing frames representing the motion source. A dedicated page locates the fixed programme and identity facts in the campaign. Scaling and presentation framing are acceptable when the reused work remains recognisable and inspectable. Merely naming deliverables, substituting different artwork, omitting a source or replacing the factual-location page with a generic claim fails.

Review the full video and its duration. It lasts 10 seconds and develops the mobile festival announcement's copy, motif, typography, palette and graphic forms. The actual first frame contains NORTH WAVE 2027 and 12–13 November 2027. The actual final frame contains that title and date range, Independent music + digital art, Signal Hall, Foundry Yard, Tide Archive and the intact supplied organiser mark. Essential motion copy respects the mobile safe region in 05-carrier-geometry.png. Animation and transitions may vary; a different visual identity, incorrect duration, missing required endpoint content or altered organiser mark fails.
